title: poa arundinacea
intro: Poa arundinacea, commonly known as tall meadow-grass or June grass, is a perennial grass species belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which can help alleviate respiratory problems and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Poa arundinacea include its ability to reduce inflammation and fight off infections, making it a potential remedy for wounds and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
